summary: The document reconciliation correctness harness uses two independent symbol definitions and disjoint instance cohorts to distinguish dependent updates from unrelated work. An A-only definition change must alter A geometry/style and dependent hit results while retaining B definition/descendant and instance identities, complete markup, computed fill and hit identity, with zero observed B mutations, including parent child-list records for moves of B roots. Causal controls cover a semantically identical B definition clone, a B root removal/reinsertion at its original position, and a redundant B attribute write, so output equality alone cannot qualify noninterference. The self-contained functional witness is shared by the self-running document suite and the ordinary packed-browser test via Playwright evaluation of the same actual function, with its result retained in normal browser observations; adding the witness to the self-running suite alone did not make existing CI execute it. This is an existing SvgDocumentBrowserHost.Replace test boundary, not a new renderer, optimization, public API or proof of browser execution. Source preparation and static/Node checks do not establish the compiled browser case, performance, GPU, package publication, installed adoption or product acceptance. The initial actual packed-browser attempt failed at the B initial hit assertion; it did not preserve the evaluated hit values, so the cause remains unresolved. The source repair positions glyphs and differential hit probes inside the symbol viewport and emits bounded actual/expected/probe evidence on failure; a clip-edge explanation is an inference until genuine successor qualification. The owning SVG plan remains canonical.
title: Definition replacement needs a disjoint unchanged-definition witness
